fusions.name: Flung Clod
fusions.desc: Flings a clod of mud that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dredge Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses silt at a target up to 5 tiles away for 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Bank Up
fusions.desc: Raises your maximum health by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you recover 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
